S11.description: Table S11 (mmc12.xlsx): SMR of endometrial splicing (LeafCutter intron-cluster sQTL, 206 samples; effect columns keep the SMR eQTL header names) on endometriosis (Rahmioglu 2023 GWAS). One top sQTL per intron probe (probeID). b_eQTL and b_GWAS are harmonised to A1, and b_SMR = b_GWAS / b_eQTL.

Yang2025-1.notes: Top sQTL rs12470971 for GREB1 intron 2:11588931:11592776 (clu_53175). Single-variant Wald ratio; b_SMR 0.1317 = OR 1.1408. A second GREB1 intron in the same cluster (2:11588931:11591396, rs72772088) has the opposite sign and is not this claim.

Yang2025-2.notes: Top sQTL rs143511013 for WASHC3 intron 12:102046119:102050189 (clu_42350). Single-variant Wald ratio; b_SMR -0.0933 = OR 0.9109.

Yang2025-3.notes: Top sQTL rs1222220 for ARL14EP intron 11:30331374:30332866 (clu_68773). Single-variant Wald ratio; b_SMR -0.0444 = OR 0.9566. Two other ARL14EP introns in S11 (11:30323202:30330886 and 11:30323202:30332866) are different probes, not this claim. This probe has p_HEIDI 5.3e-6, so it fails the HEIDI test.

Yang2025-4.notes: Top sQTL rs926855 for RP11-624M8.1 intron 6:125645700:125720424 (clu_62702). Single-variant Wald ratio; b_SMR 0.0617 = OR 1.0637. Two other introns of this cluster (rs926853) are different probes. This probe has p_HEIDI 1.5e-4, so it fails the HEIDI test.
